# pinzone

> The IANA timezone at a coordinate, exact at the points you care about, with no file reads at runtime. Build a small JSON table offline with `npx pinzone build`, commit it, and call `createLookup(table)` in serverless code.

pinzone is a TypeScript/JavaScript library and CLI for Node 22+. geo-tz is needed only at build time, as a dev dependency.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, install, quick start, troubleshooting
- [Agent skill](skills/pinzone/SKILL.md): the workflow and rules a coding agent should follow

- [CLI reference](skills/pinzone/references/cli.md): every command, flag, message and exit code
- [Setup guide](skills/pinzone/references/setup.md): points files, JSON imports in TypeScript and bundlers, CI
